reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the environment in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now managed more efficiently, ensuring smoother gameplay. You can raise terrain, dig trenches, and turn on wells without freezing the game. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
